countingDefinitions.mobileRouteFiles: Total .tsx files in apps/mobile/app/ (includes 2 layouts and 51 route screens).
countingDefinitions.mobileStores: Count of store files in apps/mobile/stores/ (*.ts).
countingDefinitions.apiRouteModules: Count of TypeScript route files in apps/api/src/routes/ (*.ts).
countingDefinitions.apiEndpointsTotal: Count of HTTP method registrations in routes and server.ts matching app/fastify.<method>(...).
countingDefinitions.sqlMigrationFiles: Count of .sql files in supabase/migrations/ (exact count 36, numbered 001-034 plus 0035 and duplicated 023).
countingDefinitions.uniqueDatabaseTables: Set of distinct table names created via CREATE TABLE across all 36 migrations.
countingDefinitions.uniqueDatabaseViews: Set of distinct view names created via CREATE VIEW across all 36 migrations.
countingDefinitions.uniqueDatabaseFunctions: Set of distinct stored functions created via CREATE FUNCTION across all 36 migrations.
countingDefinitions.uniqueDatabaseTriggers: Set of distinct triggers created via CREATE TRIGGER across all 36 migrations.
countingDefinitions.directSupabaseCallers: Files in apps/mobile importing or calling Supabase client directly.
countingDefinitions.railwayApiCallers: Files in apps/mobile referencing Fastify API gateway client or base URLs.
countingDefinitions.localFallbackFiles: Files in apps/mobile with mock IDs, placeholders, or silent fallback returns.
